title: Knight's & Magic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A genius programmer and robot otaku is reborn in a world of knights and magic as Ernesti Echevalier ('Eru'), where giant humanoid machines called Silhouette Knights fight. With childhood friends Archid and Adeltrud he trains to pilot them and uses his engineering know-how to build his ultimate robot, with world-changing results (Crunchyroll blurb via MU; AniList). Manga adaptation of a light novel, 17 volumes, complete.
life_message: Passion, study and hard work can turn a hobby into something that changes the world.

content.note: Mecha and monster battles (MU Monsters, Piloted Robots); detail not checked.
